commit.message:
Slice platform-deep-links: tg:// / t.me deep-link handling via getDeepLinkInfo (#240)

* parity:platform-deep-links — t.me/tg: deep-link handling via getDeepLinkInfo

Launch with a tg:// / t.me / telegram.me link argument: main.rs stashes it
on the app, getDeepLinkInfo fires once auth is Ready, the tg:// action is
parsed from the textEntityTypeTextUrl entities, and the follow-up request
(searchPublicChat / createPrivateChat / joinChatByInviteLink) opens the
chat — with message/post jump, story viewer, and /start prefill (never
auto-send). need_update_application and unknown links show TDLib's info
text in a kit dialog. Linux assets/quill.desktop registers
x-scheme-handler/tg.

Out of scope (DECISIONS.md): single-instance handoff, tg://proxy,
Windows/macOS scheme registration, auto-sending /start, startgroup=
semantics, in-app updater.

* fmt: cargo fmt --all

* fixup: handle tg://privatepost and tg://user deep links

parse_tg_url returned None for tg://privatepost (the t.me/c/<id>/<msg>
form, the most common t.me message-link shape) and tg://user?id=, so those
links degraded to an info dialog. Add OpenChannelPost and OpenUser
actions: privatepost resolves via getChat with the TDLib channel dialog
id (-(10^12) - channel_id) and jumps to the post through the existing
jump pipeline; user resolves via createPrivateChat like openmessage.

Also fix the DeepLinkAction::OpenUsername doc (startgroup= is out of
slice and ignored) and the 'link TDLib resolved' -> 'link TDLib
requires' comment typo in chat_list.rs.

* docs: note privatepost/user in deep-links decision fragment

* fix(deep-links): confirm invites, scale message IDs, and capture dialog proof

parity:platform-high-contrast — real high-contrast theme mode (#228)

* parity:platform-high-contrast — real high-contrast theme mode

Adds ThemeChoice::HighContrast as a third Appearance theme: pure-black
surfaces, white text/borders, yellow links, deep-blue fills, with the
dark kit theme underneath (the kit has no HC variant). HC wins over
auto-night; Toggle Theme cycles Light → Dark → High contrast. The
chat_theme palette is orthogonal (3-value pick(): Some(hc) overrides,
None keeps the dark value — semantic hues were designed for black
backgrounds). Includes a ui-gated palette contract test, a ThemeChoice
serde/legacy-prefs test, QUILL_DEMO_THEME=high-contrast for screenshots,
and parity-fragments/parity-platform-high-contrast.txt (plus
docs/decisions/parity-platform-high-contrast.md) so the merge pipeline
checks the README box.

* proof: capture high-contrast appearance

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

Platform: paste image from clipboard into composer (#241)

* Slice parity:platform-paste-image — paste clipboard images as photo attachments

The kit Textarea's paste is text-only, so register a Paste handler on the
app root that bubbles after the Textarea's own handler. When the composer
has focus and the clipboard holds ClipboardEntry::Image, the encoded bytes
are written to a temp file and attached as a photo via the existing
ComposerAttachment::pick path (canonicalization + album rules unchanged).
Search boxes and dialogs keep plain text paste (composer-focus gate).

* proof: ready-paste-image GPUI screenshot for parity:platform-paste-image

Wire ScreenshotDemo::ReadyPasteImage (--screenshot-demo ready-paste-image)
with a composer photo attachment chip (demo-thumb.png) and capture
docs/screenshots/ready-paste-image.png via Xvfb+ffmpeg. Updates the
decision fragment proof line to the real PNG path.

* fmt: wrap ready paste image status note

---------

Co-authored-by: shinycake <shinycake@users.noreply.github.com>

Platform: retry countdown on flood/rate-limit errors (#237)

* Slice parity:platform-flood-errors — retry countdown on flood/rate-limit errors

Flood errors were classified (ErrorClass::Flood) but surfaced only
generic 'wait and try again' lines.

- TdError gains flood_wait_secs, extracted from FLOOD_WAIT_<n> in
  parse_error before the raw message is dropped for secret-scrubbing;
  TdError::flood_line() renders 'try again in N seconds' when known.
- password_op_error_line + sessions_error_line Flood arms use it.
- AuthRequestError carries the seconds through; user_message() shows
  the countdown ('too many code attempts — try again in 30 seconds')
  or the static line when unknown.

* fixup: address adversarial review (flood countdown)

- src/state/requests.rs: one-line fix from review defect
- src/telegram/envelope/auth.rs: review nits
- DECISIONS.md: sync wording

* docs: declare parity:platform-flood-errors via fragments

Fragment-based parity contract (#234): do not hand-edit README/DECISIONS.
